paragraphs.text: Many adults sleep less than the seven hours that doctors recommend. One common reason is the use of phones and tablets in bed, because the light from screens can delay the release of the hormone that makes us feel sleepy.
Experts advise going to bed and getting up at the same time every day, even at weekends. A regular pattern helps the body clock to predict when it is time to sleep.
What we eat and drink also matters. Coffee can keep people awake for up to six hours after drinking it, and a heavy meal late in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep.
A cool, dark and quiet bedroom is ideal. If noise from traffic is a problem, earplugs or a fan that produces steady background sound may help.
Short naps during the day can improve alertness, but naps longer than thirty minutes may leave people feeling tired and make it harder to sleep at night.

items.quote: the light from screens can delay the release of the hormone that makes us feel sleepy
keywords: delay the release of the hormone

explanation.en: Screen light “can delay the release of the hormone that makes us feel sleepy” → C.
explanation.kk: Экран жарығы «can delay the release of the hormone that makes us feel sleepy» → C.
explanation.ru: Свет экранов «can delay the release of the hormone that makes us feel sleepy» → C.

items.quote: A regular pattern helps the body clock to predict when it is time to sleep

explanation.en: A regular pattern “helps the body clock to predict when it is time to sleep” → B.
explanation.kk: Тұрақты тәртіп «helps the body clock to predict when it is time to sleep» — ағза ұйықтайтын уақытты біледі → B.
explanation.ru: Регулярный режим «helps the body clock to predict when it is time to sleep» — организм знает, когда пора спать → B.

items.quote: Coffee can keep people awake for up to six hours after drinking it

explanation.en: “Coffee can keep people awake for up to six hours” → F. G exaggerates: the text does not ban coffee.
explanation.kk: «Coffee can keep people awake for up to six hours» → F. G асыра айтады: мәтінде кофеге тыйым жоқ.
explanation.ru: «Coffee can keep people awake for up to six hours» → F. G преувеличивает: запрета на кофе в тексте нет.

items.quote: a heavy meal late in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep
items.prompt: A large meal in the evening
keywords: heavy meal late in the evening

explanation.en: On food: “a heavy meal late in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep”. “Large” paraphrases “heavy” → A. F is about coffee.
explanation.kk: Тамақ туралы: «a heavy meal late in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep». «Large» — «heavy» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы → A. F тамақ емес, кофе туралы.
explanation.ru: О еде: «a heavy meal late in the evening can make it harder to fall asleep». «Large» пересказывает «heavy» → A. F про кофе, а не про еду.

items.quote: If noise from traffic is a problem, earplugs or a fan that produces steady background sound may help

explanation.en: Earplugs help “If noise from traffic is a problem” → D. E is about naps, not earplugs.
explanation.kk: Құлақ тығыны «If noise from traffic is a problem» кезде көмектеседі → D. E құлақ тығыны емес, күндізгі ұйқы туралы.
explanation.ru: Беруши помогают, «If noise from traffic is a problem» → D. E про дневной сон, а не про беруши.

options.text: can make it hard to fall asleep if eaten late.
helps the body know when it is time to sleep.
can delay the release of a sleep hormone.
may be useful if the bedroom is noisy.
should last no more than thirty minutes.
can keep people awake for several hours.
